title: Relay board pairs each status label with its item in a multi-item run
findings_note: s331 gate 2026-10-17: in a multi-item run the ended line's status cell lists labels without item ids (tui.py around line 1368)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the single-item ended line, the outcome glyph rule, or colors (s297).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s331 shows the items' configured status labels beside a finished run. A run with more than one item lists the labels without saying which item each belongs to, so `review, done` cannot be read without opening each item.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`, the ended summary in `board_lines`: for a run with more than one item, render each label as `ID label`.
- `tests/test_tui.py`; `docs/tui.md` if it shows the line; `CHANGELOG.md`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch the first go red.
2. Pair ids with labels for multi-item runs; keep the narrow-screen order s331 set.
3. Docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
